title: Photoelectricity

sections.heading: 1. Photoelectric Effect
sections.proseLatex: Photoemission occurs when light frequency $>\nu_0$ (threshold). Einstein's equation: $K_{\max} = h\nu - \phi_0$.

sections.heading: 2. Solar Photovoltaic Cell
sections.proseLatex: Photons generate electron-hole pairs in a semiconductor, producing current.

keyFormulas.label: Stopping Potential
keyFormulas.aiExplainContext: Maximum KE measured by stopping potential.

workedExamples.problemLatex: Two metals illuminated with $\lambda_1 = 350$ nm and $\lambda_2 = 540$ nm. Compare max speeds.
stepsLatex: Shorter wavelength $\Rightarrow$ higher photon energy $\Rightarrow$ higher $K_{\max}$.

wbjeebTraps: Photoelectric effect is instantaneous — no time lag.
